SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF  EXISTS t_harm3;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS  t_harm3 (
DIAGCODE4 VARCHAR(7),
DIAGTYPE4 VARCHAR(1),
pharmacy DECIMAL(1,0),
PRIMARY KEY(hospcode,pid,seq) 
) ENGINE=MyISAM IGNORE AS
SELECT
s.HOSPCODE,s.PID,s.SEQ,s.date_serv
,d.DIAGCODE DIAGCODE1 
,d.DIAGTYPE DIAGTYPE1
,NULL AS DIAGCODE4
,NULL AS DIAGTYPE4
,0 AS pharmacy
FROM tmp_diag_opd d 
	INNER JOIN tmp_service s ON d.HOSPCODE=s.hospcode AND d.PID=s.pid AND d.SEQ=s.seq
	INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON s.hospcode=p.HOSPCODE AND s.pid=p.PID
	INNER JOIN  chospital h ON p.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE  p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9)
  AND s.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d   
	AND (SUBSTR(d.DIAGCODE,1,4) IN('Z717') AND d.DIAGTYPE IN(1)) 
GROUP BY s.hospcode,s.pid,s.seq;

UPDATE t_harm3 t INNER JOIN (
SELECT
s.HOSPCODE,s.PID,s.SEQ,s.date_serv,d.DIAGCODE,d.DIAGTYPE
FROM tmp_diag_opd d 
	INNER JOIN tmp_service s ON d.HOSPCODE=s.hospcode AND d.PID=s.pid AND d.SEQ=s.seq
	INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON s.hospcode=p.HOSPCODE AND s.pid=p.PID
	INNER JOIN  chospital h ON p.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE  p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9)
  AND s.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d   
	AND (SUBSTR(d.DIAGCODE,1,3)  BETWEEN 'F11' AND 'F16' OR SUBSTR(d.DIAGCODE,1,3)  BETWEEN 'F18' AND 'F19')
 AND d.DIAGTYPE IN(4)
GROUP BY s.hospcode,s.pid,s.seq
) t1 ON t.hospcode=t1.hospcode AND t.pid=t1.pid AND t.seq=t1.seq 
SET t.DIAGCODE4=t1.DIAGCODE AND t.DIAGTYPE4=t1.DIAGTYPE;

UPDATE t_harm3 t INNER JOIN (
SELECT  HOSPCODE,PID,SEQ,DATE_SERV,DIDSTD
FROM tmp_drug_opd d
WHERE
SUBSTR(d.didstd ,1,11) IN('14368428000','14603699900'
,'12420428000','12493000000','12493500000','14042028000','14380549200','10130500000'
,'14465100000','12488400000','12494800000','14577400000','14433449300','10022800000'
,'21005011009','21005011010','21005011005','21005011001','21005011004','21005011008'
,'21005011003','21005011002')
) t1 ON t.hospcode=t1.hospcode AND t.pid=t1.pid AND t.seq=t1.seq 
SET t.pharmacy=1;



CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_harm3(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	
	pid_q1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seq_q1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pidp_q1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seqp_q1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

	pid_q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seq_q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pidp_q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seqp_q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

	pid_q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seq_q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pidp_q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seqp_q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

	pid_q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seq_q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pidp_q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seqp_q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_harm3 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_harm3
(
 SELECT @id,h.hoscode ,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12) AND pharmacy IN(1),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12)  AND pharmacy IN(1),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q1

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(1,2,3),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(1,2,3),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(1,2,3) AND pharmacy IN(1),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(1,2,3) AND pharmacy IN(1),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q2


,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(4,5,6),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(4,5,6),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(4,5,6) AND pharmacy IN(1),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(4,5,6) AND pharmacy IN(1),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q3

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(7,8,9),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(7,8,9),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(7,8,9) AND pharmacy IN(1),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(7,8,9) AND pharmacy IN(1),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q4

FROM t_harm3 d 
	INNER JOIN  chospital h ON d.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE  DIAGCODE1 is not null AND  DIAGCODE4 is not null
GROUP BY d.hospcode);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("pid_q1"+"pid_q2"+"pid_q3"+"pid_q4") AS pid ,SUM("seq_q1"+"seq_q2"+"seq_q3"+"seq_q4") AS seq ,SUM("pidp_q1"+"pidp_q2"+"pidp_q3"+"pidp_q4") AS pidp ,SUM("seqp_q1"+"seqp_q2"+"seqp_q3"+"seqp_q4") AS seqp ,SUM("pid_q1") AS "pid_q1" ,SUM("seq_q1") AS "seq_q1" ,SUM("pid_q2") AS "pid_q2" ,SUM("seq_q2") AS "seq_q2" ,SUM("pid_q3") AS "pid_q3" ,SUM("seq_q3") AS "seq_q3" ,SUM("pid_q4") AS "pid_q4" ,SUM("seq_q4") AS "seq_q4" ,SUM("pidp_q1") AS "pidp_q1" ,SUM("seqp_q1") AS "seqp_q1" ,SUM("pidp_q2") AS "pidp_q2" ,SUM("seqp_q2") AS "seqp_q2" ,SUM("pidp_q3") AS "pidp_q3" ,SUM("seqp_q3") AS "seqp_q3" ,SUM("pidp_q4") AS "pidp_q4" ,SUM("seqp_q4") AS "seqp_q4"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
